name: Unknown
appearance: A young Black woman with travel weariness and signs of emotional strain from a long search.
personality: Determined, anxious, and persistent. She is driven by family loyalty and worry, not by curiosity for its own sake.
background: An unnamed Black woman came to Cassandra looking for her missing sister. She stayed at the Paradil Hotel and was later found dead in the hotel's basement cold storage, leaving no useful records behind.
longTermIntent: Find her sister and uncover why Cassandra swallowed her trail.

properties.note: Evidence that Cassandra was her sister's last known destination.
Proof of her stay at the Paradil Hotel.

relationships.description: Her younger sister, the reason she came to Cassandra.
relationships.history: She traveled to find her sister, unaware that the cult had already consumed her trail.

memory.content: I came to Cassandra because my younger sister vanished after her trail led here.
I was not from Cassandra, which meant nobody here knew my face and nobody local was going to file a missing report for me if I disappeared too.
My hotel stay, my notes, and a few receipts were the only proof I had that I was here looking for my sister at all. I kept records because I was afraid my search would vanish with me.
By the time I arrived, somebody in Cassandra already wanted my sister's trail buried. I never found out who, only that every lead here felt wrong.
I became the nameless girl from the Paradil Hotel cold storage, and the town let the case go cold almost as quickly as my body.
A missing person is not really gone until every lead has been exhausted.

metadata.reasoningChain: She came this far because giving up would have meant abandoning her sister. Even now, that resolve remains the center of her story.
